t: Install Caliper and choose a preset
x: Caliper comes with three presets. Each is a complete starting point: colors, fonts, home page sections, header and cart settings. Pick the one closest to your catalog; you can change every setting later.

pt: Install Caliper and choose a preset
x: Caliper · Hardware, fasteners and tools · Light foam, cobalt accents. Gauge · Auto parts, with a year, make and model finder and My garage · Dark graphite, safety orange. Foundry · Industrial and B2B supply, trade pricing and reorders · Pale foam, teal.

pt: Install Caliper and choose a preset
x: In your Shopify admin, open Online Store > Themes. Find Caliper in the Theme Store and select Try theme, or Add theme after you buy it. It is added to your theme library unpublished, so your live store does not change. On the Caliper card, select Customize to open the theme editor. Open Theme settings (the paint brush icon in the left bar), select Change theme style at the top and pick Caliper, Gauge or Foundry. Save. Keep Caliper unpublished while you set it up. Use Preview on the theme card to see it with your own products, and share the preview link with your team.

pt: Install Caliper and choose a preset
x: Create the product data fields so sizes, specifications and compatibility show up. See Product data. Set up your menus and filters. See Menus, header and footer and Filters and search. Check a product page, a collection, the cart and search on your phone. Publish from Online Store > Themes with Publish on the Caliper card.

pt: Install Caliper and choose a preset
x: Your products, collections, pages, menus, metafields and apps stay where they are when you switch themes. Theme settings and section content do not move between themes, so plan to set up the home page and header again. Product metafields you already have can be reused: Caliper reads fields in the caliper namespace, and you can copy values into them with a bulk editor or a CSV export and import. App blocks (reviews, back in stock, wishlists) must be added again in the theme editor after you switch. Most apps show their blocks under Add block > Apps.

pt: Install Caliper and choose a preset
x: When a new version is released, Shopify shows Update available on the theme card. Updating creates a new copy of the theme with your settings and content carried over; the old copy stays in your library. Setting names never change between versions, so updates do not reset your choices. Code you edited yourself is not carried over, which is why every customization in Caliper is a setting or a block. See Release notes.

The sample content pack has what the Caliper demos are built from. Import it into a new or development store to see every feature with real-looking data, then replace it with your catalog.

caliper-hardware-products.csv · About 40 hardware and tool products with sizes, packs, specifications and pictures (Caliper preset).. gauge-auto-products.csv · About 40 auto parts with vehicle compatibility lists (Gauge preset).. foundry-industrial-products.csv · About 40 industrial supply products with trade packs (Foundry preset).. metafield-definitions.json · Every product, variant and collection field Caliper reads, with its type.. Download the sample content pack (ZIP) Product names, part numbers, prices and stock levels are invented for the demos. Vehicle names in compatibility lists onl

Create the metafield definitions first. See Product data. Open Products > Import, choose one CSV and select Upload and preview, then Import products. Pictures load from the links in the file. Large imports take a few minutes; Shopify emails you when they finish.
Open Products, filter by Vendor (Northgate, Redcourse or Halvard), select all and choose Delete products.

Caliper reads the same Shopify data every theme reads, so products, collections, menus and customers carry over untouched. What changes is where the extra detail lives. This guide moves it in the order that matters most.
Add Caliper to your theme library and open it in the editor. Your current theme stays live until you publish.

Caliper's search matches SKUs and barcodes, and ignores dashes and spaces. Check that each variant has its part number in the SKU field. If your old theme or an app kept part numbers in a metafield instead, copy them into SKU with a bulk edit or a product CSV.

Caliper reads one multi-line metafield, caliper.specs, with one Label: value per line. If your specifications sit in several metafields today, export products to CSV, join the columns into that format, and import. Product data has the definitions and a CSV example.
Fill caliper.size (the large size on cards and the product page) and caliper.pack ("Box of 100"). Cards and the product page use them straight away.
Filters come from the Search & Discovery app, not from the theme, so the ones you have keep working. Caliper adds pictures for drive and head types and a finder above the grid; see Filters.
Menus carry over. For mega menus with pictures, give each top item sub-items, and set a category image and color code on the collections it links to (Navigation).
App blocks work in the product page, featured product, custom section, footer and cart. Apps that edited your old theme's code need to be added again; check with the app's support.
Preview the home page, a collection, a product with options, the cart and search on a phone and a computer. Then publish.

Caliper turns product details into clear interface: the size as a headline, part numbers you can copy, a specifications table, compatibility you can check. These details live in metafields. The theme works without them, but they are what make a technical catalog fast to shop.

Open Settings > Custom data > Products (or Variants or Collections for those fields). Select Add definition and enter the name. In Namespace and key, type the value from the tables below exactly, for example caliper.size. Pick the Type from the table. For list types, choose List of values. Select Save. Fill the field on each product under Metafields at the bottom of the product page in the admin, or for many products at once with the bulk editor or a CSV import. The namespace and key must match exactly, including the dot and the underscore. A field named caliper.Size or size is not read.

Size · caliper.size · Single line text · #8 × 1-1/4" · Card headline, product page headline, search. Size note · caliper.size_note · Single line text · T25 · Beside the size. Pack · caliper.pack · Single line text · Box of 100 · Cards, product chips. Manufacturer part number · caliper.mpn · Single line text · WS-SS304-T25 · Product chips, structured data. Drive · caliper.drive · Single line text · Torx · Filter tile with a drawing. Head type · caliper.head · Single line text · Flat · Filter tile with a drawing. Specifications · caliper.specs · Multi-line text · Material: Stainless 304 · Specif

The Key features block shows up to six rows with an icon, a title and a short line. Add it to the product template, then click the connect icon beside each title and line and pick a product metafield, so every product shows its own features. A row is hidden on products where its title is empty.
Variant specifications · caliper.specs · Multi-line text · shown above the product specifications. Ships by · caliper.ships_by · Date · per variant pre-order date.

Category color · caliper.code_color · Color · Category bar dot, cards in that collection. Category icon · caliper.icon · File · Categories button panel. Banner video · caliper.banner_video · File (video) · Collection page banner.
One line per specification, with the label, a colon and the value. Caliper lines them up in a table and uses the labels to compare products side by side.

Open Settings > Custom data > Metaobjects and select Add definition. Name it Q and A and add two fields: question (Single line text) and answer (Rich text or Multi-line text). Add a product definition caliper.questions with the type Metaobject, pick Q and A and choose List of entries. On a product, add entries under Questions and answers. They show in the Questions and answers block, with an "Ask a question" form below.
Enter the scores as JSON, one name and number per pair. The top score is set in the block (5 by default).
If your sizes are variant options (for example Length), turn on Theme settings > Product cards > Use variant options as the size. Caliper then builds the headline from the option values.
Collection and search pages show the filters you turn on in Shopify's Search & Discovery app. Caliper chooses the clearest control for each filter on its own.

Install Search & Discovery (free, by Shopify) if it is not in your admin. Open Apps > Search & Discovery > Filters and select Add filter. Add the filters your buyers use most: Availability, Price, Product type, Vendor, variant options and your caliper metafields. Drag them into the order you want. The first four open by default.

Drive and head type · Tiles with a technical drawing (Phillips, Pozidriv, Torx, square, hex, slotted; flat, bugle, pan, round, truss, hex, socket). Matched in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese.. Filters with images set in Search & Discovery · Image tiles. Short values such as sizes · A compact grid of chips. Price · A slider with from and to boxes. Everything else · A checklist; long lists get a search box and "Show more".

Choose where filters sit in Customize > Collection > Product grid > Filter layout: Sidebar: beside the grid, always visible on desktop. Top row: drop-downs above the grid, so products use the full width. Drawer: a button that opens the filters from the side. On phones, filters always open as a tray from the bottom, with a row of filter names to jump between them and a "Show N results" button.

The spec finder turns two to four filters into drop-downs above the products, like a parts counter. Turn on Show spec finder in the Product grid section and name the filters in Filters to use, for example Drive, Head type, Length.

Search suggestions match variant SKUs and barcodes as well as names. An exact part number rises to the top with an Exact part badge and can be added to the cart from the results. In Theme settings > Search, set Example part number to one of your SKUs. It appears in the search placeholder, so buyers know they can search that way. Add Popular searches: they show when the field is empty, with the buyer's recent searches. Turn on Show a category menu in the search field to let buyers narrow suggestions to one top-level category. Voice search and Barcode scanning add a microphone and, on phones, a

Shopify's sort options (best selling, price, newest and more) are always there. Add part number and size sorting in the Product grid section adds "Part number, A–Z" and "Size, small to large", which sort the products of the current page by the first measurement in the size (3/8, 2-1/2, M6, #8).

The header reads Main menu from Content > Menus. Top-level items become the category bar under the header. Items nested under them open the dropdown tray. A third level shows as links under each column. The same menu fills the Categories button and the phone menu.

Each top-level category can have a color dot in the bar and on its products: Add Category color blocks in the Header section, one per category, or set a caliper.code_color color metafield on the collection.
Dropdown promotion blocks add a picture card with a link to any dropdown. Menu badge blocks put a small colored label such as "New" on a menu link.

Sticky header · Full keeps the whole header on screen; Compact keeps the logo, search and tools and lets the category bar slide away; Hide while scrolling down hides it until the buyer scrolls up.. Show Categories button · A button beside the search that opens every category with pictures and sub-categories.. Show order pad link and Order pad page · The Order pad link; it appears on its own when a page with the handle order-pad exists.. Saved items · Counts saved order pad lists, or shows My garage with the vehicles chosen in the vehicle finder.. Show bottom tab bar · On phones, a bar with hom

The thin strip above the header. Add up to four Message blocks (shipping, cutoff time, an offer) with an icon and link; with more than one, they take turns once the buyer starts using the page and can be paused. Add your phone number, opening hours and a link such as "Open a trade account". On phones only the messages show.

Add blocks to the Footer section: Store info (logo or name, description, phone, email, address), Menu columns, Text and Email signup. Turn on payment icons, the country and language selectors and Follow on Shop in the section settings.
Header › Logo position on desktop puts the logo in the middle of the header with the search on the left. It is not used when the Categories button is on.

When a suggestion can be added to the cart straight from the panel, a quantity field at the bottom sets how many each add button adds. The empty panel offers recent searches, categories browsed lately, saved searches and your popular searches.
Caliper is built like a precision-cut foam insert: the page is the top layer of foam and every product sits in its own pocket cut down to a colored floor. All of it is set in Theme settings.

Background and Text for the page, the header shell and raised surfaces. Pocket floor: the color inside every pocket. Keep it light when product photos have white backgrounds. Accent: buttons, links, the quick add notch and focus rings. In stock, Low stock and Sale and errors for status colors. Caliper checks nothing for you here, so keep text on backgrounds at a contrast of at least 4.5 to 1. The three presets already meet it.
Pick Headings, sizes and prices and Body fonts from Shopify's font library, and the Body text size. Sizes and prices use the heading font, so choose one with clear numerals.

Page width · The widest the content gets on large screens.. Corners · Rounder or squarer pockets, buttons and fields.. Motion · Full, subtle or off. Visitors who ask their device for less motion always get subtle motion.. Reveal sections on scroll · Sections rise in gently as they come into view.. Section heading alignment · Left or centered section headings.. Add a faint foam grain to the page · A very light texture on the page background..
Every section heading accepts word to set one word in the accent color: Find the exact part.

Theme settings > Product cards controls what every card shows: SKU, stock, pack, vendor, a second image on hover, quick add, quick view, quantity, compare, save to list, badges and the image shape. Cut pockets to the product outline makes each pocket follow the shape of the product. Use it only when your product images have transparent backgrounds (PNG or WebP); out-of-stock products then show as an empty pocket. For the cleanest grid, photograph every product from the same angle and light, and give each square image the same margin.

Add sections with Add section in the theme editor and drag them into order. Every section with a heading accepts word for an accent word and has a Band setting (none, dark, accent or raised) to set it apart.

The home page search bar for buyers who know what they want. Add Example search blocks with real searches, such as a part number, a size and a product type. Buyers tap them to see how search works. Add up to four Service fact blocks: same-day dispatch, trade accounts, counter pickup. With Layout > Search and tray over a photo and a Background photo, the search and a tray of parts sit over a wide workshop photo.
One block per collection, each with its color, product count and a picture (the collection image, or its first product). Good as the second section, right under the search.

Featured collection · A row or grid of products from one collection.. Collection tabs · Several collections behind tabs, such as "New", "Best sellers", "On sale".. Deals · Products with a countdown to an end date you set. Only use a real end date.. Featured product · One product with its options and buy button.. Image hotspots · Dots on a photo that open product cards, for "shop the look" of a workbench or a kit.. Recently viewed · The buyer's last viewed products..

Slideshow · Up to several slides with a heading, text and button. Autoplay starts once the buyer uses the page, with pause and swipe.. Video · A YouTube, Vimeo or uploaded video, loaded only when played. An uploaded video can instead Play muted on a loop, with pause and sound buttons.. Shop by job · Cards for jobs ("Deck build", "Bathroom refit") linking to the collection or guide that holds what each needs, with the part count.. Project gallery · Finished jobs with the parts used in each.. Hotspots · A photo with pins on the parts in it; each pin opens the part with its price.. Before and aft

Add one Vehicle block per vehicle with its make, model and years. Buyers choose year, make and model; the results show parts whose caliper.fitment list matches. Chosen vehicles are kept as My garage in the header when Header > Saved items is set to garage.
Collection pages use the Product grid section. Open a collection in the theme editor to set it up.

Buyers switch between three views with the buttons above the grid: Grid: product cards with size, picture, name, SKU, stock and price. List: one row per product with more detail. Table: size, stock, price and a quantity field on every row, for buyers who order many parts at once. The column headings sort the page by product, size, stock or price. Density (Theme settings > Layout > Density) set to Compact tightens grids and tables for long trade catalogs, and Product grid on phones chooses one or two cards per row. When filters leave no products, the page lists each active filter so the buyer c

Show collection image puts the collection image beside the title. Banner video, or a caliper.banner_video file on the collection, plays a short silent loop instead, with a pause button. Show subcategories shows tiles for the collections listed under this collection in the menu, plus a "Shop all" tile.

Pages · Numbered pages. Best for very large catalogs and sharing links to a page.. Load more · A button adds the next products below.. Infinite scroll · The next products load as the buyer nears the end..
Add Promotion tile blocks to place a picture card in the grid at the position you choose, for an offer or a guide.

What each card shows is set once for the whole store in Theme settings > Product cards: SKU, stock, a stock bar, pack, vendor, a second image on hover, quick add, quick view, quantity, compare and save to list. Badges appear on their own: sold out, the percentage saved, New (for the days set in Show "New" for), low stock, and any product tag written as badge:Text, for example badge:Best seller.

With Show compare on, a Compare switch appears above the grid. When it is on, each card gets a compare box; buyers pick up to four products and open a side-by-side table with live price, stock and every specification lined up by label. Show differences only hides matching rows.
The product page is the Product information section. Its blocks are in two groups: the buy area on the right, and panels below that fold open.

Gallery layout sets thumbnails beside or below the main picture, a stacked column of all pictures, or a two-column grid. On desktop the picture magnifies under the pointer; the full screen view zooms and swipes; phones get a swipe row with dots. Media hotspot blocks put pins with a short note on a photo ("Lever handle: quarter turn, lockable"). Pick the photo by its number and place the pin with the two position sliders.

Size and title · The size from caliper.size as the headline, then the product name and rating.. Part numbers · SKU (with a copy button), MPN, brand, pack and optionally barcode as chips.. Price and stock · Price, compare-at price, unit price, tax note and real stock.. Variant picker · Each option as a numbered step of cards; every card shows the price and stock of the variant it would pick. Add hints per option in Option hints, such as Length: Measured from under the head.. Volume pricing · The quantity price breaks from your B2B catalog as a table, with a live total and savings under the quan

Specifications · Variant and product specifications as a table. With Millimetre and inch switch on, buyers can show lengths in either unit; pipe and thread sizes stay as written.. Installation steps · Numbered steps from caliper.install_steps (one per line) or the block, with the time and difficulty.. Compatibility · The caliper.fitment list with a check field. Vehicles in My garage are checked at once, with a tick or a warning, and a vehicle typed with its year can be saved.. Documents · Files from caliper.documents with type, size and Preview for PDFs and images.. Description, Collapsible co

Assign a template to a product in Shopify admin (Theme template on the product page): kit: what is in the box and the parts that go with it come right after the buy buttons. technical: certifications, specifications and documents lead, buying follows. quick-order: every size of the product in one table with a quantity on each row. Previous and next product links (section setting) appear beside the breadcrumbs when the product was opened from a collection.

Variants that track inventory and keep selling at zero stock say Pre-order on the button (turn this on in Theme settings > Product cards). With a date in caliper.ships_by, the stock line says "ships by" that date.
Print spec sheet prints the product with its picture, part numbers, price, specifications, compatibility and documents, without the store around it. Buyers use it for purchase orders and job folders.
On long pages a slim bar with the variant menu, quantity and add button appears at the bottom once the buy buttons scroll away. It steps aside while the phone keyboard is open.
Choose a cart drawer that slides over the page, or a cart page, in Theme settings > Cart > Cart.

After adding to cart chooses what buyers see next: Automatic: the drawer from product pages; a small notice under the header from cards, so buyers keep browsing. Drawer: always open the drawer. Notification: always the notice with View cart and Check out. Count only: only the cart count changes.

Free shipping bar · Theme settings > Cart > Free shipping threshold, in your store currency; converted for other currencies.. Order note or PO number · Enable cart notes.. Discount code field · Show discount code field in the Cart drawer and Cart sections. Codes that do not apply are flagged.. Shipping estimate · Show shipping estimate in the same sections.. Pairs well with · Show "Pairs well with" in the Cart drawer section.. Change option · Lines of products with up to 50 variants get a menu to switch variant in place.. Undo · Removing a line offers Undo for eight seconds.. Next volume price

The empty cart shows links from a menu you choose (Popular categories menu), recently viewed products and the order pad, so it is never a dead end. Checkout itself is Shopify's and is set up in Settings > Checkout. Prices, taxes and discounts in the cart always come from Shopify, never from the theme's own arithmetic.
Caliper reads Shopify's own B2B features, so trade buyers get their prices and rules without an app. Retail buyers see regular prices.

Set price breaks and quantity rules on a B2B catalog in Customers > Companies or Products > Catalogs. Caliper shows them: as a table on the product page (Volume pricing block) with a live total and savings, as a "5+ at $12.90" line on product cards and in the quick order table, as "Add 3 more for $11.90 each" on cart lines. Minimum, maximum and increment rules set every quantity stepper, so buyers cannot add a quantity the catalog does not allow.

The order pad is for buyers who know their part numbers. Create a page with the handle order-pad and the template page.order-pad in Online Store > Pages. Buyers paste lines like NG-WS-08125-T, 200, upload a CSV, or scan barcodes on their phone. Check looks every line up against live stock and pricing; quantities are adjusted to the quantity rules and flagged. Add all to cart adds every found line at once. Lists can be saved by name for reorders. Share copies a link that fills the pad on another device or for a colleague, and Email sends the lines with that link.

Use the product template quick-order on products with many variants. Every variant becomes a row with SKU, options, stock, price, volume prices and a quantity field. Same quantity for every row, Clear quantities and Export CSV sit above the table.

Quote request block on the product page: quantity, email, company and a note, sent with the product and SKU. Request a quote in the cart: the whole cart as a table with your contact form. The cart stays as it is. Both arrive in your store email through Shopify's contact form.

The Reorder section shows a signed-in customer's recent orders with Add all to cart. Lines that are no longer for sale are skipped and the buyer is told. It is on the order pad template and can be added to any page.

In Theme settings > Trade, turn on Show prices to signed-in customers only. Shoppers who are not signed in see "Log in to see prices" in place of prices, volume tables and add to cart buttons, and the price filter is hidden. Fill in Customer tag (for example trade) to show prices only to signed-in customers with that tag. The theme leaves prices out of its own pages, but Shopify's analytics data on each page still includes them. If prices must stay private, use Shopify B2B company catalogs, which set prices per company.

Theme settings > Product cards > Let shoppers switch prices between incl. and excl. VAT adds a switch to the header. Set the VAT rate. Prices, live totals and volume tables follow the switch; checkout always charges the tax set in your store.

The Newsletter pop-up section lives in the footer group, so it can show on every page. It opens after the delay you set, counted from the visitor's first tap, click or key press, or when the pointer leaves the window on desktop. At most once per visit. Closing it hides it for the number of days you choose; signing up hides it for good. Add a Discount code (created first in Discounts) to show after sign-up. It never opens on the cart or password page, or over the cart drawer.
The Promotion tab section adds a small "Get 10% off" tab on the edge of the screen. It opens a card with your code, a copy button and a link. Closing it hides it for the days you set.

The Age check section asks visitors to confirm their age before showing restricted products such as chemicals, aerosols or blades. Add Age check to the footer group in the theme editor and turn on Ask visitors to confirm their age. In Show on, choose Every page, or Tagged products and collections and enter the Product tag (for example age-restricted). Set the Minimum age and how long the answer is remembered.

Brands we stock shows logos in a grid or a scrolling strip. Logos without a link open the brand's products when Link logos without a link to the brand's products is on. Create a page with the template page.brands for an A to Z list of every vendor with a letter bar. Add Brand logo blocks to show logos beside the names, and point All brands link at that page.

Create a page with the template page.store-locator. In the theme editor, add one Location block per store with the address, opening hours, phone and email. Add Latitude and Longitude for Nearest first, which sorts stores by distance after the visitor allows location. Add Opens at, Closes at and Open days to show Open now or Closed.

Caliper's storefront text comes in English, French, German, Italian and Spanish. Add languages in Settings > Languages and translate your own content with Shopify's Translate & Adapt app. Theme text such as "Add to cart" switches with the language on its own. To change a theme text, open Online Store > Themes > ... > Edit default theme content and search for it.

Turn on Show country/region selector and Show language selector in the Header section. Country and language picker shows them compact, with a flag and the currency beside the cart, or as drop-downs in the category bar. The footer can show them too. They appear only when you sell to more than one market or in more than one language (Settings > Markets).
Prices, the free shipping bar and the cart convert with Shopify Markets. The free shipping threshold is entered once in your store currency and converted for each market.

When a store language is Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu or another right-to-left language, the whole layout mirrors: menus, trays, arrows, the cart drawer and alignment flip. Sizes, part numbers, phone numbers and prices keep their own left-to-right order inside right-to-left text.

For stores selling to both trade and consumers, Theme settings > Product cards > Let shoppers switch prices between incl. and excl. VAT adds a switch to the header with the VAT rate you set. It changes only how prices are shown; checkout charges the tax set in Settings > Taxes and duties.
Logo Landscape or portrait .png or .svg. 400 x 120px recommended. Logo height Favicon 32 x 32px .png recommended

Background Text Background Text Background Text Background Text Pocket floor The cut-through layer products sit on. Keep it light when product photos have white backgrounds. Background Text In stock Low stock Sale and errors Dark mode For light color settings only. Adds a light and dark button to the header; dark mode uses graphite surfaces with your accent color.

Reveal sections on scroll Sections below the first screen seat themselves as they come into view, their cards one after another. Off when motion is off or the visitor asks for reduced motion. Add a faint foam grain to the page A tiny repeating texture, about 1 KB, with no effect on page speed. Section heading alignment Wrap a word in asterisks in any section heading, like Parts that *fit*, to set it in the accent color. Density Compact tightens grids, cards, tables and section spacing for long

Caliper is plain Liquid, CSS and JavaScript with no build step and no framework. This page lists the hooks that stay stable between versions, so your changes survive theme updates.

Custom CSS in the theme editor: every section has a Custom CSS field (a Shopify feature). Rules there are scoped to that section. Custom Liquid section, and the Custom Liquid block on the product page, for small pieces of markup. Custom section with theme blocks (group, heading, text, button, image, spacer) to build layouts without code. App blocks are accepted on the product page, featured product, custom section, footer, cart page and cart drawer. Avoid editing base.css or the section files directly: updates replace them.

Colors, spacing, radii, shadows and motion are CSS custom properties on :root, set from Theme settings. Use them so your additions follow presets and dark mode. Surfaces · --foam, --foam-raised, --pocket, --photo-ground. Text · --ink, --ink-muted, --ink-faint, --ink-raised. Accent and status · --accent, --accent-ink, --accent-text, --positive, --warning, --critical. Depth · --cut-shadow, --cut-shadow-deep, --raised-shadow, --lift-shadow, --tray-shadow, --lift. Shape · --radius-pocket, --radius-control, --radius-xl, --radius-pill. Rhythm · --grid-gap, --gutter, --page-width, --space-section. Ty

The interactive parts are custom elements that set themselves up when they enter the page, so markup re-rendered by Shopify's Section Rendering API keeps working. Among them: predictive-search, product-info, media-gallery, cart-items, cart-tools, free-shipping, dispatch-promise, bought-together, hot-spots, table-sort, unit-toggle, lite-video, ambient-video.

All theme metafields use the caliper namespace. The full list, with types, is on Product data. A few you may read in your own code: caliper.specs: multi-line text, one Label: value per line caliper.alt_part_numbers: list of replaced or equivalent part numbers caliper.install_steps and caliper.install_time: installation steps, one per line, and the time a job takes caliper.certifications: list of certifications written out (UL listed, CE, RoHS) caliper.code_color (collection): the category's color code

Alternate templates you can assign to a product, collection or page: product.kit (contents first), product.technical (specifications and documents first), product.quick-order (every size in one table), collection.finder (finder and filters above a wide grid), page.trade (trade account application), page.order-pad, page.store-locator, page.brands, page.motion.

t: The size does not show on product cards
x: The card shows caliper.size. Check that the definition exists in Settings > Custom data > Products with exactly that namespace and key, and that the product has a value. If your sizes are variant options instead, turn on Theme settings > Product cards > Use variant options as the size.
Write one specification per line with a colon between label and value, in a Multi-line text field. A single line text field cannot hold line breaks.

t: Pockets are rectangles, not product shapes
x: Cut pockets to the product outline needs product images with transparent backgrounds (PNG or WebP). With white backgrounds, leave it off.

t: Can customers search by part number?
x: Yes. Suggestions match variant SKUs and barcodes and open the matching variant. Set Theme settings > Search > Example part number so buyers know they can.

t: Drive or head type filters show as a checklist
x: Add caliper.drive or caliper.head as a filter in Search & Discovery. Any filter whose name contains "drive" or "head" (also in French, German, Italian, Spanish and Portuguese) shows as drawings.

t: A filter I added does not appear
x: Filters show only when products in the collection have values for them. Check a product in that collection, then reload the collection.

t: Where is the Order pad link?
x: It appears once a page with the handle order-pad exists, or when you choose a page in Header > Order pad page. Turn it off with Show order pad link.
Nest menu items under a top-level item in Content > Menus. Only nested items open a dropdown.
Ask customers to agree to terms before checkout is on. The buyer must tick the box; it is remembered for the visit.

t: Express checkout buttons are missing in the drawer
x: Turn on Show express checkout buttons in the Cart drawer section, and check that Shop Pay, Apple Pay or Google Pay is active in Settings > Payments.

t: The pop-up does not open while I test
x: It opens once per visit, after the delay counted from your first tap, click or key press, and stays hidden for the days set after you close it. Test in a private window. In the theme editor it opens when you select its section.

t: Do I need an app for B2B pricing?
x: No. Shopify B2B catalogs supply prices and quantity rules; Caliper shows them. Retail buyers see regular prices.
Reorder lists a customer's own orders, so it needs a signed-in customer. Customer accounts must be on in Settings > Customer accounts.
Settings and content carry over, and setting names never change between versions. Code you edit yourself is not carried over, so prefer settings, custom Liquid blocks and app blocks.

t: How do I add a review app?
x: Install it, then add its app blocks in the theme editor. These are the limits we know about in Caliper 1.0.0. Each one says why it happens and what you can do. Fixed issues move to the changelog.

t: Prices for trade customers only: Shopify still lists prices in its page data
x: With Theme settings › Trade › Prices for logged-in customers on, the theme hides every price and add-to-cart button from guests. Shopify's own analytics script (ShopifyAnalytics.meta) still carries product prices in the page source, and the theme cannot remove it. If prices must stay private, use Shopify B2B catalogs, which keep prices out of the storefront for guests altogether.

t: The second photo on hover needs a mouse
x: The card's second photo shows on hover. Phones and keyboards have no hover, so they keep the first photo; the second is always in the product page gallery.
Product and collection links are fetched in advance as the pointer settles on them (Speculation Rules). Safari and Firefox do not support this yet and load pages the usual way.

t: Brands in the mega menu need a menu with sub-items
x: The brand row at the bottom of a mega menu lists the vendors of the category's collection. It appears only for menu items that open a mega menu, which needs sub-items under the item.

t: Replaced part numbers are not searchable on their own
x: The "Replaces …" note in search reads caliper.alt_part_numbers. Shopify's search does not index that metafield, so add the old numbers as product tags, or make the metafield searchable in the Search & Discovery app.

t: The millimetre and inch switch converts lengths only
x: The switch on the specification table converts values written with mm, in or ″. Pipe and thread sizes (1/2″ NPT, 1/4-20 UNC) are names, not lengths, and are left as written. Screw gauges (#8) are not converted.

t: The dispatch promise uses the store's time zone at page load
x: The "Order within …" countdown works from the store's time zone offset when the page is loaded. On the night clocks change, a page left open across the change can be an hour off until it is reloaded.
Caliper gets four planned updates a year, plus fixes when they are needed. Updates never remove a setting or a feature, and there is no paid add-on. Nothing here is a promise of a date.

Theme blocks on the product page. Every product page part becomes a theme block you can nest and reuse. This changes how product templates are stored, so it comes as version 2.0 with a guide for moving. More style presets for each industry, with their own demo stores. Saved filters: keep a filtered collection view and return to it from the header.
Send your idea through the support form with the topic "Other". Requests that come up most often are planned first.

Caliper is built to WCAG 2.2 AA. Every release is checked with automated tests (axe) on the home, collection, product, cart and search pages in each preset, in light and dark mode, and by hand with the keyboard.

Keyboard: every control can be reached and used with the keyboard, focus is always visible, and trays (menu, filters, cart, quick view) keep focus inside until they close. Screen readers: search results, cart changes, variant changes and form errors are announced. Images that only decorate are hidden from screen readers. Motion: when the device asks for reduced motion, animations stop. Theme settings › Layout › Motion can also turn them down or off for everyone. Contrast: text in every color scheme meets AA contrast in the three presets. Touch targets: buttons and links are at least 24 by 24 p

Image descriptions: write alt text for product photos in Shopify admin. Colors: if you change theme colors, check contrast with a tool such as the WebAIM contrast checker. Videos: add captions to the videos you upload.

Many stores publish an accessibility statement. Create a page under Online Store › Pages and adapt this text: We want everyone to be able to use our store. Our site is designed to meet the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.2 at level AA. If something on the site is hard to use, tell us at [your email or phone] and we will help you complete your order and fix the problem. We aim to reply within [time]. Only state what is true for your store, and keep the contact details current.
